clips.title: The story
paras: Beyond the Train Depot, Workshop Entrance gives a backdoor into Gnomeregan. The route opens near the Engineering Labs and bypasses the front gates, offering another way into the irradiated city.

Past the Train Depot, Workshop Entrance crosses the cavernous workshop floor toward the industrial heart of Gnomeregan. The opening to the Loading Room lies on one side. This passage runs straight to the Engineering Labs, avoiding the fortified entry gates near the surface, where leper gnomes and troggs contest the way. For those trying to reclaim the underground capital, this side door bypasses the first perimeter.
